subject: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novex.ai>, Novex Ops <ops@novex.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Hi Jane / Novex Ops team,

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation I attached an updated capacity model (novex_capacity_model_v2.xlsx) with a couple of scenarios: "base", "peak+20%", and "spiky burst". Two asks to keep us moving:

1) Can you confirm the traffic forecast for Oct 20-28 (time series + p95 qps) so we can lock the acceptance run schedule?
2) We can provision a small compute-credit buffer (short-term reserved capacity) to cover the first 72 hours of swap if you'd like — I listed a provisional credit schedule in the sheet. Please confirm whether Novex wants Redwood to front that or if you'll use your cloud credits.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Dry run (sizing validation / KV-cache warm-up): Oct 20, 08:00-12:00 PT
- Final cutover window (DNS + routing switch): Oct 24, 00:00-04:00 UTC
- Post-cutover validation: Oct 24, 04:00-12:00 UTC

Attachments: novex_capacity_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

If that works for you we'll drop into a short dry-run runbook next (swap_runbook_draft.md) and I will loop in infra for quota checks.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

---
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novex.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novex Ops <ops@novex.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — we reviewed the model. Quick answers and an FYI:
- We attached our traffic export for Sep->Oct (peak_traces_sep_oct.csv). The expected p95 around Oct 22 is ~1.8x our average; sudden bursts (short lived) are common between 01:00-03:00 UTC.
- We do not currently have available cloud credits to front the swap. If Redwood can provide that buffer as a temporary measure that would be ideal (we can reimburse on invoice).

We need the dry-run to include a short user-journey test (API flows for our high-throughput endpoint) and a failover simulation to hosted API for at least 5 minutes.

We can tentatively approve dry-run Oct 20 — confirm the exact time and required pre-warm instructions.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Director of Platform Engineering, Novex AI
jane.doe@novex.ai

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Hannah — quick read of Novex traces and the attached model. A few notes and a recommended change to the timeline:

Observations:
- The Sep->Oct traces show short bursts that push sustained token rates ~2.1x baseline for 5-7 minutes. That pattern will materially affect burst throughput if we under-allocate GPU headroom.
- Their p95 latency objective is 120ms for the in-house endpoint; we need to confirm acceptable degradation during the first 24h post-cutover.

Recommendations (actions for the dry-run):
- Increase the "peak+20%" scenario to "peak+40%" in the model and re-run the simulated batching profile (I noted the cell changes in column H).
- Dry-run date: move to Oct 20, 09:00-13:00 PT (extra hour to include failover test).
- Cutover: move to Oct 24, 01:00-05:00 UTC to better align with Novex low-traffic window per their traces.
- Pre-warm steps: 48-hour cache seeding, and 2 incremental KV replay passes in the 6 hours before the dry-run.

Operational asks for infra team (Marcus):
- Confirm GPU bring-up ETA for +8 A100-equivalent slots by Oct 16 (we may need a quota uplift request).
- Prepare a short fallback route that shifts 25% traffic back to hosted for the first 30 minutes if errors > 0.5% (runtime circuit-breaker).

I'll take ownership of updating the capacity spreadsheet and sending a readout we can share with Novex.

- Karthik

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Looks good. A couple operational constraints from capacity provisioning side:

- Request quota uplift to cloud provider by Oct 15 EOD — lead time for provisioning A100-equivalent dedicated slots is variable (48-72h typical) but requests can take longer if region busy.
- If uplift isn't approved by Oct 16 12:00 PT we'll need to pivot to a staged capacity approach: allocate what we have and keep a hosted overflow pool for immediate bursts (we can do fast routing).

Attaching a draft swap checklist (swap_runbook_draft.md) with step-by-step roles. Please review the runbook and call out any missing validation steps.

Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: swap_runbook_draft.md (markdown)]

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novex.ai>, Novex Ops <ops@novex.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Jane — forwarding Marcus and Karthik's notes and the draft runbook. Two things we need from you to finalize:
1) Confirm whether Novex wants Redwood to front the compute-credit buffer (we'll invoice as a one-time charge).
2) Sign off on the Oct 20 dry-run (09:00-13:00 PT) and Oct 24 cutover (01:00-05:00 UTC).

If you confirm today we'll file the quota uplift request and publish the final runbook.

Thanks,
Hannah

[Attachment: novex_capacity_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

---
From: Novex Ops <ops@novex.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novex.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novex Dedicated Onboarding: compute credits, sizing dry-run & swap window

Hannah — confirmed:
- Novex will accept Redwood fronting a short-term compute-credit buffer; please provide the draft charge schedule (we'll sign and reimburse).
- Dry-run Oct 20 09:00-13:00 PT is approved. Cutover confirmed for Oct 24 01:00-05:00 UTC.

Requests before dry-run:
- A single point of contact from Redwood during the window (name and mobile).
- A test API key with limited scope and pre-warm instructions to perform the user journey tests.
- A short escalation matrix (who to call at T+0/T+5/T+30).

Attached: novex_onboarding_signoff.pdf (pdf) — internal approval record.

Thanks,
Novex Ops
ops@novex.ai
